entities.summary: David Jeffrey Frum is a Canadian-American conservative political commentator and a former speechwriter for President George W. Bush. He is a senior editor at The Atlantic. David Frum was a legal figures from Toronto (b. 1960-06-30, Toronto). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
